home.heroSubtitle: Tables, vessels and mirrors carved from marble, onyx, travertine and solid wood. Reserve yours with a pre-order — no payment needed today.
home.howStep1Body: Browse the collection and pick the size, finish and quantity you need.
home.howStep2Body: Submit a pre-order. There is no online payment — it's a reservation request.
home.howStep3Body: Our team contacts you to confirm details, final price and delivery time.

about.title: About us
about.bannerSubtitle: Natural stone and solid wood, shaped by hand in our Tehran workshop.
about.companyImageAlt: Stone slabs in the Sense Of Stone workshop
about.story1: Sense Of Stone makes furniture and objects from marble, onyx, travertine and solid wood. Every piece starts with choosing the right block or plank — its colour, veining and grain decide what it will become.
about.story2: Our craftsmen cut, carve and finish each piece in our Tehran workshop, combining modern machinery with careful handwork. Because we make to order, sizes, finishes and details can be adjusted to your space.
about.story3: From dining tables and coffee tables to vessels, plates and mirrors, our goal is simple: honest materials, lasting quality and service that stays with you from the first question to delivery.
about.missionBody: To craft natural stone and wood pieces of the highest quality, and to make ordering them simple and personal — from choosing a design to confirming the final details with our team.
about.visionBody: To be the name people trust for natural stone and wood in their homes: exclusive pieces, made with care, that exceed the expectations of every customer.
about.visionImageAlt: Finished stone piece in a living space
